survey: A wall-mounted split air conditioner sits on a striped green wall, with a room corner and ceiling line at the top left of the card. The camera is slightly below the unit and to its right. That is why the long front face shows, the right end cap (blue-grey) shows as a narrow side face, and part of the underside shows, with the air outlet and its louver flap. The front face's top edge drops slightly toward the left. Its bottom edges and the trim strip stay close to horizontal (about 2°). So the long edges converge gently toward a vanishing point off to the left. The ceiling line also drops toward the left, so the wall and the unit share that vanishing direction. The vertical edges of the front face and the end cap stay vertical (about 86°), and so do the wall stripes. The vanes inside the outlet all lean the same way, which fits seeing them from below and to the right. The house logo lies flat on the front face, which is almost square to the camera. The unit sits flush against the wall, and its soft shadow falls below it and to the right. The left end cap is hidden, which fits a camera on the right.
